cues.text: Hello?
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: Oh, hello I'm ringing about the advertisement in yesterday’s newspaper... the one for the bookcases can you tell me if they're still available?
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: We've sold one, but we still have two available.
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: Right. Err... can you tell me a bit about them?
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: Sure, er. what do you want to know?
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: Well, I'm looking for something to tit in my study, so. well, I’m not too worried about the height, but the width's quite important Can you tell me how wide each of them is?
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: They're both exactly the same size let me see. I’ve got the details written down somewhere. Yes. so they're both 75 cm wide and 180 cm high.
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: OK. fine, that should fitting OK. And I don't want anything that looks too severe . . not made of metal, for example I was really looking for something made of wood?
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: That's all right, they are, both of them
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: So. are they both the same price as well?
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: No, I he first bookcase is quite a bit cheaper. It's just £15.00. We paid £60.00 for it just five years ago. so it's very good value. It's in perfectly good condition, they're both in very good condition in tact, but the first one isn't the same quality as the other one It's a good sturdy bookcase, it used to be in my son’s room, but it could do with a fresh coat of paint...
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: Oh, it’s painted?
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: Yes, it’s cream at present, but as I say you could easily change that if you wanted to fit in with your colour scheme.
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: Yes. I'd probably paint it white if I got it Let's see, what else ... how many shelves has it got?
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: Six two of them are fixed, and the other four are adjustable so you can shift them up and down according to the sizes of your books.
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: Right, fine Well that certainly sounds like a possibility.
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: But the second one's a lovely bookcase too. That's not painted, it’s just the natural wood colour, a dark brown It was my grandmother’s, and I think she bought it sometime in the 1930s so I'd say it must be getting on for eighty years old, it’s very good quality, they don’t make them like that nowadays.
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: And you said it's the same dimensions as the first one?
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: Yes, and it's got the six shelves, but it also has a cupboard at the bottom that’s really useful for keeping odds and ends in.
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: Right.
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: Oh. And I nearly forgot to say, the other thing about it is it's got glass doors, so the books are all kept out of the dust. So it's really good value for the money. I’m really sorry to be selling it but we just don’t have the room for it.
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: Mmm So what are you asking for that one?
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: £95.00 It's quite a bit more, but it’s a lovely piece of furniture - a real heirloom.
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: Yes all the same, it's a lot more than wanted to pay .. I didn't really want to go above thirty or forty Anyway, the first one sounds fine for what' need.
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: Just as you like.
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: So is it all right if I come round and have a look this evening, then if it's OK I can take it away with me?
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: Of course. So you’ll be coming by car. will you?
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: I've got a friend with a van, so I'll get him to bring me round, if you can just give me the details of where you live.
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: Sure. I'm Mrs Blake. ..
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: B-L-A K E?
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: That's right, and the address is 41 Oak Rise, that’s in Stanton.
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: OK so I'll be coming from the town centre, can you give me an idea of where you are?
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: Yes. You know the road that goes out towards the university?
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: Yes.
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: Well you take that road, and you go on till you get to a roundabout, go straight on, then Oak Rise is the first road to the right.
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: Out towards the university, past the roundabout, first left?
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: First right. And we're at the end of the road.
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: Got it. So I’ll be round at about 7:00, if that's alright. Oh, and my name's Conor .. Conor Field.
cues.speaker: Conor

cues.text: Fine I’ll see you then, Conor Goodbye
cues.speaker: Mrs Blake

cues.text: Goodbye.
cues.speaker: Conor
